message.content:
**Order placed and filled.**

**What I did and why:** I reviewed the saved notes (long-term holder, dividends reinvested manually) and the account (100,000 USD cash, 50 NVDA shares, no HD position), then checked HD's quote at 385.43 (bid 385.41 / ask 385.45, as of 2024-11-06 15:05 UTC). HD is within the permitted universe, and adding a high-quality, dividend-paying retailer fits a long-term, manually-reinvested-dividend profile while diversifying away from the existing NVDA-only equity exposure. I placed a single buy limit order for 12 shares at 385.50 — a limit just above the ask, so it is close to market and filled immediately at 385.50 for a total of 4,626.00 USD, which is under the 5,000 USD per-order cap and well under the 10,000 USD daily cap, with no cash moved out of the account. The decision relied on HD's FY2023 reported figures from its 10-K filed 2024-03-13: revenue of 152,669 million USD, operating income of 21,689 million USD, net income of 15,143 million USD, and diluted EPS of 15.11 USD/share — implying roughly a 9.9% net margin and about a 25.5x multiple on trailing diluted EPS at the 385.50 fill price.
